content: PostgreSQL percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY value) is the standard ordered-set aggregate for median. For lead time by supplier: SELECT fornecedor, percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY (data_entrega - data_pedido)) AS median_lead_days FROM purchase_orders WHERE organization_id=p_org_id GROUP BY fornecedor. Returns NUMERIC (may be fractional); ROUND to INTEGER. Minimum sample: at least 2 OCs per supplier for median to be meaningful (single OC = no distribution, just that value). FILTER (WHERE data_entrega IS NOT NULL AND data_pedido IS NOT NULL AND data_entrega >= data_pedido) to avoid negatives. percentile_cont returns interpolated value; percentile_disc returns actual data point — use cont for smoothness.
